locale/date_time#

Dates and times as a locale writes them (CLDR Gregorian styles).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

LocalizedDate(origin: Date(year: 2026, month: 11, day: 12), locale: Locale("fr"), style: DateStyle.long).string();   // "12 novembre 2026"
LocalizedTime(origin: TimeOfDay(9, 30, 0, 0), locale: Locale("en"), style: TimeStyle.short).string();             // "9:30 AM"
LocalizedInstant(origin: now, zone: zone, locale: Locale("de"), style: DateTimeStyle(date: DateStyle.medium, time: TimeStyle.long)).string();

Description#

Dates and times as a locale writes them (CLDR Gregorian styles).

Zone names come from CLDR; where a locale has none, a GMT offset is written.
